text:
Alex (Growth Marketing): Quick ask — need a compact graphic kit for the benchmark landing + webinar hero with accessibility and localization in mind. Timeline: 3 working days. Anyone free to take this? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Maya (DesignOps): I can take the lead. Clarify scope: hero + 3 benchmark charts + 2 social tiles + Figma library tokens?
Alex (Growth Marketing): Yes to all. Also need a dark mode variant and an SVG/PNG export. Must include alt text and copy variations for en, fr, de, ja.
Jordan (Product Designer): will mock hero + chart templates. Quick question — do we have final numbers for the charts/benchmarks or should I use placeholders?
Priya (Content Marketing): Use the latest benchmark CSV from drive (v3_final_benchmarks.csv). I'll paste the key callouts here: 1) median latency 120ms, 2) 3x cost reduction vs baseline, 3) 99.9% p50 SLA. Those copy lines need simple variants for localization.
Sam (Brand): A few constraints: follow updated color tokens (see brand tokens doc), maintain 4.5:1 contrast for body text and 3:1 for large display, no decorative gradients on data charts. Also prefer Inter variable for headings.
Maya (DesignOps): Confirming WCAG AA contrast for main text. I'll run the contrast checker and include alt text for each asset. For localization, how long can the French/DE copy be? We should design with 30% longer width.
Priya (Content Marketing): Plan for +30% length — good call. I'll provide translated strings by EOD tomorrow.
Jordan (Product Designer): Draft Figma file: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/benchmark-kit-draft — ping me if you can't access. Basic asset spec below:
```
- hero: 1200x628 px, SVG preferred
- chart template: responsive SVG, export PNG @2x
- social tile: 1080x1080 px, PNG and source .fig
- naming convention: company_bench_{asset}_{lang}_{mode}.ext
```
Maya (DesignOps): Also adding an accessibility checklist to the Figma file and a small CSV that lists alt text per asset. I'll include a README with copy for translators.
Alex (Growth Marketing): Legal check: can we say "3x cost reduction"? @LegalBot can you confirm language to avoid overclaiming.
LegalBot (legal-bot): Flag: please add the qualifier "based on internal benchmark using model X and workload Y; results may vary." Send the benchmark CSV and methodology paragraph to legal@redwood.com for sign-off.
Sam (Brand): Small brand ask — please do not alter the redwood logo lockup. Provide versions with clear space and a reversed (white) logo for dark mode.
Maya (DesignOps): Deliverables I have on my list (due in 3 working days): 1) Figma library with tokens + components, 2) hero (SVG + PNG), 3) 3 chart templates (SVG + PNG), 4) 2 social tiles (PNG + .fig source), 5) alt text CSV, 6) README with localization guidelines, 7) legal qualifier copy included.
Alex (Growth Marketing): Perfect. Upload target: marketing-assets/benchmark-kit/1949056782 in GDrive and drop export zip in the marketing S3 bucket. I'll coordinate with Growth to schedule the webinar slide deck insertion. :+1:
Jordan (Product Designer): Quick note on fonts — Inter variable is fine but for embedded SVGs we'll convert to outlines for portability unless we can load Inter via CSS. Which do you prefer?
Maya (DesignOps): Convert headings to outlines in exported SVGs to avoid font fallback issues, but keep live text in Figma components for translations.
Priya (Content Marketing): I'll prepare the localized strings and a CSV of translations and post here once done.
Alex (Growth Marketing): Thanks team — @Maya please ping when first draft is up. Anyone else who wants to review accessibility or localization, please comment directly in the Figma file. :eyes:
Maya (DesignOps): Will do. ETA first draft in ~36 hours.
Jordan (Product Designer): I'll start layout now. If the numbers change, tag me with updated CSV.
Priya (Content Marketing): sending the first pass of translations later today.
Sam (Brand): I'll run a final brand QA before assets go live.
Alex (Growth Marketing): Awesome, appreciate the quick turnaround. :rocket:
